data_point: A new institutional investor or accelerator affiliation appeared
run_when: Web search results or a new directory listing are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether a new institutional investor or accelerator affiliation has recently appeared on their site, in press or on a portfolio page.
prompt.definition: Recent means within about six months of today.
yes_when: Recent press or portfolio listing naming a new investor or accelerator
watch_out_for: Angel investors alone don't count as institutional

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
